about: Step 6, temp book staging/ai.js (Mid's 17-ai, the computers): every piece. v100's ai.js is one balanced computer on two sides (D122), asking by tick, its numbers D149–D180. Mid has four computers with personalities, relations, waves: they come over as they are (bring), asking by tick and with their numbers in the books, never by kind names. in v100: already home. cut: v100 does it another way.

powerFrom: F12b: combat.js WAR.odds, a tower D177 (Mid's 120), the people D192 (250); towers by D143 less the seat
estPower: F12b: combat.js WAR.odds, the other side's army and towers
nearestType: index.html, the movables floor, findNear (the nearest find of a kind)
bestCounter: v100/ai.js round picks the counter to what the enemy fields most from D180 by D138 "vs"; Mid scores every kind it can train by who beats whom over its cost, by age and civ, and mixes the best two so an army is never one kind
timeLeft: seconds to the bell (D134): the horizon of the by-need plan
rateFrom: what one more worker earns on a yield from home (the best free find, walk and crowd counted, Charnov): with the by-need plan
goalOf: the personality's next goal (the age, a building, an army wave) and its cost: with the by-need plan and the personalities
needOf: for each yield: hands, rate, income, shortfall against the goal, time to afford it; v100/ai.js round uses a fixed share by age (D151) instead
runsOut: the reorder point (the famine runway): a store that runs out before its income can be rebuilt: with the by-need plan
famineNear: food runs out first: with runsOut
PLOTS: which plot makes which yield, and how far from the Town Center a plot goes (60 to 170): with the shift to plots; v100 builds farms only (D160, D161)
plotPays: the shift to plots: a plot is built when it beats the wild find and pays its cost back in the time left (marginal value, payback)
peaceAll: at peace with every court: with diplomacy (the army stands down to a share)
armyAim: the army a side keeps: its cap, or the stand-down share at peace: with armyCap and diplomacy
firstNeed: the first research a wanted one waits on: with the tech tree
think: Mid's computer turn: by-need jobs, homes, camps, plots, saving for the age, the Market, the Wonder, priests, medics, siege, caravans, spies, the army mix, finds, war, by personality (PERS). v100/ai.js round already does jobs, homes, camps, farms, the age, the army and the wave for one balanced side; the rest comes, asking by tick · Albert 11:16: without its surplus selling (cut for everyone)
aiDiplomacy: a computer's relations by its odds: peace when losing, war when strong, an ally when at war, all against the Throne's holder: with diplomacy (kept for after the core)
allyDuty: an ally defends a friend's town under attack, never at the cost of its own: with diplomacy
armyCap: the army a side keeps: the personality's cap plus 10 an age, to ARMYMAX; v100 has soldiers by age (D154)
lootRun: a detachment clears the nearest guarded find and hires vagabonds it passes: with the gifts (MG) and the hazards (MH)
throneRun: from the Medieval age a strong side with siege marches on the Throne: with the Throne (see misfits)
wallPlan: the computer's wall ring: an arc facing the middle, its gate the two squares nearest the middle: with the walls (BW1, BW2)
matchup: F12b: combat.js WAR.odds, the counters summed both ways over the first D193 look, the ratio held in D193 lo–hi; the counter test is vs(), which the blow reads too
newWave: combat.js WAR.waves and WAR.attack; the stalled wave goes home by D156 (v100 ai.js)
decideWar: when and whom to attack, by odds against the personality's nerve: the opportunist, Easy's safe start, Hard waiting for winter, a rival's Wonder or the Throne at once, riders on the foe's camps; v100/ai.js round sends one wave at Lanchester odds D155
LEAGUE: Dynamic Diplomacy's two numbers (forms at 1.4 of the next score, breaks below 1.15): with leagueTick
leagueTick: Dynamic Diplomacy (the Tension setting): the computers behind a runaway leader unite against it: with diplomacy (see misfits)
AB: the A/B test of the computers' head start: Albert 11:16, killed (they win enough)
storesOf: a side's whole store: with the B side's greed (AB)
gapOnRoad: the narrowest gap on the road to a foe: with chokeClaim
chokeClaim: idle foot soldiers hold the narrowest gap on the road to the nearest foe: with AB and the Choke formation

misfits: The computers march on the Throne in the middle, and everyone turns on whoever holds it. You said the Throne and the great lake come back reimagined, with the middle clear until you describe them. Hold these parts until then?
Computers ganging up on a runaway leader needs three or more sides. v100 has two (you and one computer, D122), and more computers are later. Bring it now, waiting for more sides, or hold it?

An A/B test from Nov 3: computers without the free mill and farm, pushing with raids and by holding a choke point instead. You parked replacing the free mill and farm with pressure. v100 has no free mill and farm. Should the pressure become how the computers play, or does the test stay behind?

The computer sells its surplus at the Market for gold when it saves for an age. You cut "surplus sells itself" (Nov 4). Was that only the player's automatic selling, or should the computer not do it either?
The computers see the whole map (no fog), so they know your real strength. Fog for the computers is still parked, not decided. Keep them all-seeing?
